analysis.purpose: Cross-agent onboarding: splices a vendor-neutral protocol block into each AI client's own instruction file, so every agent that opens this repo is told the same thing about recalling and recording memory.
responsibilities: Write a managed block into each client instruction file
Keep the protocol vendor-neutral so it fits any MCP-capable tool
Install, list and remove per client and per scope

businessRules.rule: The block is spliced between markers so a user's own content in the same file survives untouched.
businessRules.rationale: These are user-owned files shared with other tools.

businessRules.rule: The protocol names MCP tools rather than any client-specific command.
businessRules.rationale: One text has to work for Claude, Cursor, Copilot, Codex, Windsurf and Gemini alike.

nodes.name: Cross-agent onboarding
nodes.summary: One memory protocol installed into every client.

edges.rationale: This file installs the neutral protocol.
